title: On degree bounds of $k$-uniform hypergraphs with bounded matching number
summary: We study the connection between the degree sequence of a $k$-uniform hypergraph and the size of its largest matching. Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a $k$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices and let $d_1(\mathcal{F})\ge d_2(\mathcal{F})\ge\cdots\ge d_n(\mathcal{F})$ be the vertex degrees arranged in non-increasing order. For integers $k\ge 2$, $s\ge 2$ and $n > 2sk$, we prove that if the $2sk$-th largest degree satisfies $d_{2sk} > \binom{n-1}{k-1} - \binom{n-s}{k-1},$ then $\mathcal{F}$ contains a matching of size at least $s$.
